newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary market cap nears emerging average - bourse.
newsitem.headline: Hungary market cap nears emerging average - bourse.

text.p: The Budapest Stock Exchange's (BSE) equity market capitalisation has risen to around 20 percent of Hungary's gross domestic product (GDP), from around 12 percent at the end of 1996, a BSE official said on Tuesday.
"The market capitalisation as a proportion of GDP is around 20 percent," Jozsef Rotyis, CEO of the BSE told a one-day conference in Budapest, titled "Road to the Bourse."
"This (20 percent) is rather close to the emerging market average which is around 25 to 30 percent," he said.
The BSE has been among the fastest growing emerging markets in 1997 (and also in 1996), rising around 50 percent to over 6,000 points from 4,134.31 points at the end of 1996.
According to BSE figures, the bourse's share market capitalisation grew to 1,251.5 billion forints at the end of April, from 852.5 billion forints at the end of December.
